script: A Greenland shark may live for around 400 years. Scientists estimated their age by dating the lenses of their eyes. That makes them the longest-living animals with a backbone that we know of. They swim very slowly, at about 1 kilometer per hour. Scientists think they may not have babies until they are about 150 years old. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
